prompt:
Our editorial fiction team uses an internal AI-assist platform to help editors with repetitive review tasks. We need a new skill added to the platform for 'Chapter Continuity Review' (章节连贯性审查) — this skill should help editors verify that character emotions, props, timelines, and relationship labels stay consistent across chapters.

The platform has its own documentation format and a strict validation system. Please create this skill properly in the repository so it passes the platform's automated validator. The skill should cover at least the review workflow steps, an output template, and example cases — organized in whatever structure the platform requires.

The final deliverable is the skill's documentation living under `skills/章节连贯性审查/` and passing the validator script.
